title: French Prawn Paella
description: A French twist on the traditional Spanish dish, featuring succulent prawns and a mixture of sweet and savory flavors.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced chorizo and cook for 2-3 minutes, until browned.
Add the chopped onions and cook for 3-4 minutes, until softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the prawns and cook for 2-3 minutes, until pink.
Add the chicken broth, white wine, tomato paste, and smoked paprika. Stir to combine.
Add the paella rice and stir to coat with the liquid.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10-12 minutes, until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove from heat and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
